title: G3 fix round 3: run_worker binds reviewed to None before the review guard so a review task without inputs falls back to its own task instead of raising NameError (review T-0345)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 211e674, 6edc2f3 and af0144e (T-0271, T-0336, T-0344) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0345 on T-0344, one finding:
1. (high) orchestrator/spawn.py run_worker: reviewed is only assigned inside the guard if role == "review" and t.get("inputs") and isinstance(t["inputs"][0], str) (around line 450), but line 467 reads it unconditionally (src = reviewed if reviewed is not None else t). A review task with no inputs, empty inputs or a non-string inputs[0] (create_task defaults inputs to [] and bus_create_task can be called directly) raises NameError instead of the graceful fallback scoped_diff(t) had before af0144e. Initialise reviewed = None before the guard (or restructure so src is computed once with the same fallback the old scoped_diff used) and keep the KeyError handling.
2. Add tests/test_spawn.py::test_review_without_inputs_falls_back_to_task: a review task created with inputs=[] reaches the render step without raising and its prompt is built from the task itself (use the wt short-circuit and the file's sandbox conventions like the sibling tests).
Keep every T-0336 and T-0344 test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id in the message; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows af0144e, 6edc2f3 and 211e674 below your commit
orchestrator/spawn.py never reads reviewed on a path where it can be unbound (reviewed = None precedes the guard, or src is computed in one expression with a fallback)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
